return-response.set-body: {"error":"missing_token","error_description":"Bearer token required. See WWW-Authenticate for authorization guidance."}

choose.otherwise:
<set-variable name="oboError"
                      value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["oboResponse"]).Body.As())" />
        

          
          
            
              
              
                @{
                  var host = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Host;
                  return "Bearer"
                    + " resource_metadata=\"https://" + host + "/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource\""
                    + ", consent_uri=\"https://" + host + "/authorize\""
                    + ", error=\"insufficient_scope\""
                    + ", error_description=\"User consent to Azure DevOps is required\"";
                }
              
              
                application/json
              
              @{
                var host   = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Host;
                var oboErr = (JObject)context.Variables["oboError"];
                return new JObject(
                  new JProperty("error",             "consent_required"),
                  new JProperty("error_description", "User consent to Azure DevOps is required. Visit consent_uri in a browser to authorize, then retry."),
                  new JProperty("consent_uri",       "https://" + host + "/authorize"),
                  new JProperty("obo_error",         oboErr["error"]?.ToString()),
                  new JProperty("obo_suberror",      oboErr["suberror"]?.ToString()),
                  new JProperty("obo_error_description", oboErr["error_description"]?.ToString())
                ).ToString();
              }
            
          

          
          
            
              
              
                @("Bearer resource_metadata=\"https://" + context.Request.OriginalUrl.Host + "/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource\", error=\"invalid_token\"")
              
              
                application/json
              
              @{
                var oboErr = (JObject)context.Variables["oboError"];
                return new JObject(
                  new JProperty("error",             "invalid_token"),
                  new JProperty("error_description", "Token exchange failed. The user token may be expired or missing the required scope."),
                  new JProperty("obo_error",         oboErr["error"]?.ToString()),
                  new JProperty("obo_error_description", oboErr["error_description"]?.ToString())
                ).ToString();
              }
            
          

          
          
            
              
              
                application/json
              
              @{
                var oboErr = (JObject)context.Variables["oboError"];
                return new JObject(
                  new JProperty("error",             "obo_exchange_failed"),
                  new JProperty("error_description", "The on-behalf-of token exchange failed."),
                  new JProperty("obo_error",         oboErr["error"]?.ToString()),
                  new JProperty("obo_suberror",      oboErr["suberror"]?.ToString()),
                  new JProperty("obo_error_description", oboErr["error_description"]?.ToString())
                ).ToString();
              }
